title: Microsoft Purview: role-based access control for Exact Data Match upload authorisation
summary: The briefing distinguishes the planned RBAC option from the documented upload-group method and reports the overdue roadmap target accurately. The current controls and EDM licensing are supported; targeted searches found no published configuration or default for the planned option.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans a choice of RBAC instead of EDM_DataUploaders membership to authorise EDM data uploads.
claims.quote: Customers will be able to choose to leverage RBAC to authorize users for uploading data to the Exact Data Match (EDM) service instead of leveraging the EDM_DataUploaders security group for authorization.
